correctness.rationale: The Fourier-product zero identity is exact for each of the 216 distinct frequencies. Pairwise orthogonality is precisely adjacency by coordinate difference 2 or 4 modulo 6. The bundled exhaustive pivoted Bron--Kerbosch program constructs the graph from integer residues and provably visits each maximal clique exactly once; its five-count output sums to 248264, with 93312 incomplete. A separate NetworkX graph enumeration finds 16416 edges and independently matches every size count. The assertion is only about this finite 216-vertex universe; a finite complete enumeration is a proof for this finite claim and not for larger systems.

value.rationale: This answers a motivated sharp finite analogue of the 2024 maximal-vs-complete cube problem on the smallest natural nonbinary equal-sided three-coordinate digit cube. It identifies the entire cardinality spectrum of maximal incomplete orthogonal character sets, the exact minimum size 12, the forbidden interval 16–26, and the precise frequency-labeled multiplicities. The latter are not implied by mere existence or spectrality and can guide exact study of unextendibility. No general-dimensional significance is presumed.
